title: Trailer living room — reading on the couch
userInput: Becky curled up on the couch reading a paperback, morning
expected: A photorealistic photograph of one adult woman lying along a worn couch in a single-wide trailer's living room, feet tucked up under her and an open paperback in both hands, dressed in a loose t-shirt and leggings. Warped slatted blinds are half shut so one hard strip of morning daylight lies across the vinyl floor and the low table; the room holds a television on a stand, a coffee cup and a folded blanket. Full body shot at eye level from across the room, 35mm, natural skin texture, sharp focus.
